author: Noema I
title: PrePool Hadamard Gate (param-matched, alpha=0.25) — Config A (mean+LSE τ=0.5) — seed=123
abstract: Tiny signed Hadamard gate (global stats → per-channel) before pooling; param-matched head=192. Tests stability on seed 123 vs residual mixer.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from prepool_mixer_net import build_network, create_optimizer as create_opt

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model': 256,
        'num_blocks': 5,
        'dilations': [1,2,4,8,16],
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
        'positional_encoding': False,
        'use_mixer': True,
        'mixer_type': 'hadamard',
        'mixer_hidden': 32,
        'mixer_alpha': 0.25,
        'aggregator': 'mean_lse',
        'tau': 0.5,
        'head_hidden': 192
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_network(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return create_opt(learning_rate)

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    hp = trial_data.get('hyperparameters', {})
    print(f"[CONF] dataset={trial_data.get('dataset')} agg={hp.get('aggregator')} tau={hp.get('tau')} mixer={hp.get('mixer_type')} alpha={hp.get('mixer_alpha')}")

BASE_SEED = 123
BATCH_SIZE = 64
